caption:
Spain heads to early election Sunday as housing and immigration dominate debate

The vote may usher in a right-wing coalition to replace Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez's Socialist-led minority government. The struggle many face in buying a home has been the biggest issue of a bitter campaign. Sanchez is one of Europe's last leftist leaders.

Reported by France 24; BBC.
